blockers.finding: The candidate is a near-verbatim member of the saturated 'same-complex outflow survivor with positive RS' family already in data/oracle/compounds/registry.jsonl. Its entry_rule is [tlt_ret_10d<0, episode_event(out,onset,same,within15,min1), rs>0]. This is A4_SAME_OUT_SURVIVOR / A26_SAME_OUT_SURVIVOR_STOCH ('Executes when peers in the same complex are seeing outflow but the candidate keeps positive RS, buying the node resisting local selling') plus a single tlt_ret_10d<0 gate. It is also structurally identical to sibling D10_RATE_STRESS_OPP_OUT_DEST (same three legs; only complex_scope flips same->opposite) and to its own family-mate NEW:TERM_PREMIUM_01. The registry contains 12 SAME_OUT signals (A4, A9, A12, A13, A17, A26, A37, A39, A47, A58, etc.) and a dedicated D-family rate-stress/relief cluster (D3/D4/D5/D10). The one novel element is the tlt_ret_10d<0 leg, which merely intersects an existing survivor rule with a bond-return sign filter.

blockers.finding: Primary economic floor is NOT met. evaluation_plan.gate_hit_63d=0.55 but observed_hit_63d=0.5341880 and floor_passed.hit63_ge_55pct=false. The candidate reaches the promotion queue on abs-effect (0.0122) and era_consistent alone while failing the hit-rate floor; it is 'QUEUE ONLY — not promoted' per promotion_queue.json. A screened candidate that fails its own pre-registered primary gate should not be adopted.

Trial-family accounting was sidestepped. trial_accounting.family=null and declared_at=null; the candidate's family 'NEW:term-premium-routing' does NOT appear in dedup_context.trial_ledger_families. A new family entered the screen without prior registration, so the search_width_at_scan=110 FDR denominator does not reflect the term-premium-routing arm that produced both TERM_PREMIUM_01 and _02. Multiple-testing correction is understated.

The mechanism inverts in the live-relevant era. The tier1 trial_ledger row for NEW:TERM_PREMIUM_02 records era_direction_63d {'1999-2014':'pos','2015-2019':'pos','2020-2022':'pos','2023-2026':'neg'} and era_direction_21d {...,'2023-2026':'neg'}. era_consistent_63d=3 counts only the older positive eras; the most recent (2023-2026) era is negative-signed at BOTH horizons. The floor's era_consistent_ge_3 credit masks a sign flip in the era that matters for going live.

Spec-name vs mechanism drift. hypothesis 'Rate stress...', name 'Rate stress same outflow survivor', and spec_ref NEW:TERM_PREMIUM_02 all invoke 'term premium', but the entry_rule uses tlt_ret_10d<0 (a 10-day TLT total-return-price momentum proxy), not any term-premium series. grep of engine/oracle/ finds no term_premium column; tlt_ret_10d is bond-price momentum, which conflates duration return, term premium, and real-rate/inflation-expectation moves. The mechanistic claim ('resist rate pressure') is not what the rule measures, and mechanism_spec_mismatch=false only checks that the text references the rule's columns, not that the economic label is accurate.

observed_effect_63d=0.0122 barely clears the abs>=0.01 floor; with within_sessions=15 and min_count=1 (a loose episode gate) fires likely cluster in time, so cluster-adjusted SEs would widen the interval and could push effect below the floor.

n=1195 with min_count=1 loose gate suggests this is a broad, low-selectivity rule; contrast with A17_WASHOUT_SAME_OUT_NEG_VEL (n=262, hit 0.576) which clears the hit floor at much higher selectivity — the loose gate is buying n at the cost of edge.
reviewer.best_counterargument: Steelman: the same-complex-outflow-survivor idea is a genuine, economically motivated pattern (isolating the node absorbing capital inside a stressed complex), and the tlt_ret_10d<0 leg is a real conditioning axis the existing A4/A26 survivors do not carry — it selects survivors specifically during rate-pressure episodes rather than in aggregate, which is a distinct sub-population (the mirror-image of the family passer SEQ_TLT_RELIEF_WASHOUT, where the relief leg leads). If a full entry-set redundancy audit against A4/A26/D10 showed <85% containment (as SEQ_TLT_RELIEF_WASHOUT did at 22.6% vs A15), the rate-stress conditioning could be additive rather than a duplicate, and the sub-population might carry asymmetry the tier-1 hit-rate screen does not measure.
reviewer.minimum_fix_to_reconsider: Provide (1) an entry-set redundancy audit computing containment% of NEW:TERM_PREMIUM_02 fires against every same-out survivor and rate-stress registry sibling (A4, A26, A39, A47, D10 at minimum) demonstrating <85% overlap with each; (2) registration of the 'term-premium-routing' family in the trial ledger BEFORE the screen so the FDR denominator is honest; (3) a re-screen that clears the pre-registered hit_63d>=0.55 floor, or a re-declared ruler if 63d hit-rate is the wrong metric; and (4) an era-split showing the 2023-2026 sign is not negative, or an explicit ruling that the recent-era inversion is tolerated. Rename to reflect the actual tlt_ret_10d proxy rather than 'term premium'.
reviewer.falsifier_spec: In a forward or held-out window, condition on tlt_ret_10d<0 same-complex-outflow survivor fires and measure 63d absolute hit-rate on distinct-date clusters: if hit_63d stays below 0.55 (as in the 2023-2026 negative-era split) across >=20 distinct fire dates, OR if >=85% of its fires are contained in the union of A4/A26/D10 entry sets, the candidate is confirmed dead as an independent signal.
reviewer.human_review_question: Should NEW:TERM_PREMIUM_02 be REJECTED as (a) a duplicate of the existing A4/A26/D10 same-out-survivor + rate-stress family AND (b) a candidate that fails its own pre-registered hit_63d>=0.55 floor with a negative 2023-2026 era sign — YES to reject, or NO to defer pending a full entry-set redundancy audit and trial-family registration?
